newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs firm amid NYMEX rise, little news.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs firm amid NYMEX rise, little news.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices rose slightly in quiet trade on Friday in line with NYMEX futures, players said.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, July spot propane traded between 34.25 cents and 34.50 cents a gallon. Conway, Kansas, spot June material traded at 35.65 cents, a quarter above Thursday.
Normal butane was also a tad stronger, with Belvieu at 39.00/39.25 cents.
Meanwhile, Asian LPG prices fell this week as storage fills up ahead of the peak winter demand period.
